pages.title: Power beyond the boundary
pages.text: Energy of the Beyond is gained by absorbing the $(l:beyond/death_heart)Heart of Death$(/l).$(br2)It strengthens your essence: your health is doubled, and the souls in your $(l:beginning/army_beyond)Army of the Beyond$(/l) become more powerful.$(br2)This is more than a new source of power. It is proof that even death may be only another threshold.
